(Pattern: 10.4x.0.0/16) | Cauca .41, Huila .42, Tolima .43" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="2020" width="940" x="50" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cc_badge_d05" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dcebf7;strokeColor=#52708a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="D05" vertex="1"> style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Gerencia | 10.4x.1.0/24 (VLAN 101, WPA3-Ent)
• 7 planned staff workstations (14M down, 3.5M up)
• Reports web and center management app
• Gateway: 10.4x.1.1 (Perimeter Firewall)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="415" x="75" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_soporte" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Soporte | 10.4x.2.0/24 (VLAN 102, WPA3-Ent)
• 7 planned staff workstations | Center support
• Gateway: 10.4x.2.1 (Perimeter Firewall)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="235" width="415" x="75" y="315" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_ground_station" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#3b82f6;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e3a8a;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="Drone Ground Station | 10.4x.2.10/32
• Preloads mission packages (order, polygon, no-fly)
• Multipart upload: photos, maps, flight records
• Bandwidth: 5M down / 20M up gtd (burst 61.5M up)
• Uploads reach application & object_storage tiers
• Active path to drone_object_ingress: DENIED (CC-DRN-02)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="155" width="385" x="90" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_logistica" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Logística | 10.4x.3.0/24 (VLAN 103, WPA3-Ent)
• 22 planned clients: 2 wired desks + 20 mobile scanners
• Bandwidth guarantee: 44M down / 11M up (100% active)
• Sack reception (accept/reject), custody, code requests
• Local encrypted outbox; no general internet exit
• Gateway: 10.4x.3.1 (Perimeter Firewall)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="415" x="75" y="565" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_servidores" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Servidores locales | 10.4x.10.0/24 (VLAN 110, Wired)
Network devices, printing and commissioning zone" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="375" width="415" x="75" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_net_devs" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontSize=11;" value="Network Management Infrastructure (.1 to .49):
• Firewall Mgmt: 10.4x.10.1
• Managed PoE Switches: 10.4x.10.2 to .9
• Wi-Fi APs: 10.4x.10.20 to .49 (5 SSIDs per AP)
• Managed from Cloud Administration host via tunnel" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="385" x="90" y="790" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_printers" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontSize=11;" value="Network Code-Sheet Printers (.50 to .59):
• Ethernet printers: 10.4x.10.50 to .59
• Prints code sheets for sacks arriving without barcode
• Protocol: IPP on TCP 631 from Logística & Staff
• Print jobs stay local within center; never cross WAN
• Printers NEVER initiate traffic (CC-ADM-04: DENIED)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="385" x="90" y="895" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_laptop" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fillColor=#fffbeb;strokeColor=#f59e0b;fontSize=11;" value="Commissioning Laptop (.60) [TEMPORARY AUDIT]:
• 10.4x.10.60/32 on dedicated wired switch port
• TCP 22/443 for initial setup before VPN (CC-ADM-06)
• Disabled immediately upon site acceptance" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="385" x="90" y="1015" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_isolated_container" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#f87171;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="INTERNET-ONLY ROUTING CONTEXT (VIRTUAL ROUTER)
NO route to 10.4x networks, 10.40.0.0/13 or Cloud VPN
'La VLAN de visitantes no enruta hacia logística ni gerencia'" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="320" width="415" x="75" y="1130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_transporte" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" value="Transporte | 10.4x.4.0/24 (VLAN 104, WPA3-Pers)
• 20 planned transporter phones in yard; client isolation
• Cap: 20M down / 5M up (2M/0.5M per phone)
• Connects to public API front door over breakout
• Gateway: 10.4x.4.1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="385" x="90" y="1195" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="z_visitantes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#cbd5e1;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" value="Visitantes | 10.4x.5.0/24 (VLAN 105, WPA3-Pers)
• 10 planned guest phones; client isolation enabled
• Cap: 10M down / 2.5M up (2M/0.5M per phone)
• General web internet breakout only; SMTP 25 blocked
• Gateway: 10.4x.5.1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="385" x="90" y="1315" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="center_barrier_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#f87171;fontSize=10;lineHeight=1.35;" value="Center Inter-Zone Defense Matrix (Section 6 & 7):
• CC-GST-01 & 02: Visitantes & Transporte denied to Logística & Gerencia [AUDIT]
• CC-GST-03: Visitantes & Transporte denied to private ranges (10.40/13, Cloud) [AUDIT]
• CC-ADM-03: User zones denied to management addresses (TCP 22/443) [AUDIT]
• CC-STF-03: Staff zones denied to each other, Logística & Guests [REVIEW]
• CC-LNK-07: Inbound tunnel traffic to center denied (except cloud admin) [AUDIT]
• CC-LNK-08: Inbound internet traffic on WAN interfaces denied [AUDIT]
• CC-LNK-09: Inter-center traffic (10.40.0.0/13) denied [REVIEW]
• CC-TEL-01: Any center traffic to telemetry_ingress denied [REVIEW]
• CC-ADM-07: Servidores locales denied general internet access [REVIEW]
• CC-LOG-04 & CC-STF-05: Non-whitelisted internet ports denied [REVIEW]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="415" x="75" y="1465" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_device" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;" value="CENTER PERIMETER FIREWALL (10.4x.20.1) | Enlace a la Nube" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1830" width="460" x="510" y="180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_services" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontSize=11;" value="Local Gateway Services & Network Control (Priority 1):
• Gateway IP: 10.4x.Z.1 for all VLAN subinterfaces
• DHCP Server: UDP 67 (Leases: Staff 12h, Yard 4h, Guest 1h)
• DNS Resolver & Cache: UDP/TCP 53 conditional forwarding
• Local NTP Time Source: UDP 123 served locally (ASM-123)
• RADIUS Server: UDP 1812/1813 EAP-TLS with local CRL
• Guaranteed bandwidth: 2 Mbps down / 2 Mbps up (Priority 1)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="420" x="530" y="235" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_shaping" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fillColor=#ffffff;fontSize=11;" value="Traffic Control & Bandwidth Guarantees (Section 8):
• Priority 1: Network Control (Tunnels, DNS, NTP, RADIUS, Logs) -> 2M / 2M gtd
• Priority 2: Logistics (Receiving, scanning, code sheets) -> 44M / 11M gtd
• Priority 3: Drone (Ground station uploads & grants) -> 5M / 20M gtd (burst 61.5M up)
• Priority 4: Staff (28M / 7M gtd) & Transport App (2M / 1M gtd)
• Priority 5: Non-operational (Visitantes & Transporte) -> Cap 30M down / 7.5M up
 (Per-client cap: 2 Mbps down / 0.5 Mbps up; served last with spare bandwidth)
• Failover: Non-operational traffic suspended on cellular backup (ASM-086)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="175" width="420" x="530" y="395" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_wan1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#ffffff;fontSize=11;" value="Primary WAN Interface (10.4x.20.1 on VLAN 120):
• 100 Mbps symmetric fiber link (90 Mbps usable, 10 Mbps IPsec overhead)
• Site-to-Site VPN: 2 IPsec Tunnels to Transit Gateway Hub (CC-LNK-01/02)
 [IKEv2 UDP 500, NAT-T UDP 4500, IP 50 ESP] (Pre-production Audit)
• Local Internet Breakout (NAT) for authorized staff, guest & app traffic" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="420" x="530" y="580" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_wan2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#ffffff;fontSize=11;" value="Cellular Backup WAN Interface (LTE / 4G Router):
• Automatic failover upon primary link failure (ASM-078)
• Re-establishes same 2 IPsec tunnels (UDP 500/4500 NAT-T behind carrier NAT)
• Non-operational traffic suspended; carries operational classes only" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="105" width="420" x="530" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="fw_execution_card" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontSize=10;lineHeight=1.35;fillColor=#ffffff;" value="Top-Down Policy Evaluation Order (Section 4):
1. CC-GST-01..03: Explicit Denies for Guest/Transport to Admin/LAN [AUDIT]
2. CC-ADM-03..04: Deny Clients to Mgmt; Deny Printers Initiating [AUDIT]
3. CC-BAS-01..04: Base Services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, RADIUS, SNMP)
4. CC-LNK-01..03: IPsec Tunnels over Primary & Cellular WAN [AUDIT]
5. CC-LNK-04..05: Route 53 Resolver (53) & Internet DNS/NTP
6. CC-LNK-06: Temporary QA Testing Path (TCP 443) [TEMP, AUDIT]
7. CC-LNK-07..09: Deny Inbound Tunnel / WAN / Other Centers [AUDIT]
8. CC-ADM-01..02: Cloud Admin (22/443) & CloudWatch Logs (443) [AUDIT]
9. CC-ADM-05..06: Vendor Updates & Laptop .60 [TEMP, AUDIT]
10. CC-DRN-01..06: Ground Station Paths to App/S3 & Deny Reserved [AUDIT]
11. CC-LOG-01..04: Logistics App API (443), Printing (631), OS Updates [AUDIT]
12. CC-STF-01..05: Staff App API (443), Printing (631), Web (80/443)
13. CC-TEL-01..02: Deny Telemetry Tier, Allow Transporter Public API
14. CC-PUB-01: Public Lookup Breakout (443)
15. CC-GST-04..05: Deny SMTP (25), Allow Capped Web Breakout
16. CC-DEF-01: Final Explicit Default Deny All (Logged) [AUDIT]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="340" width="420" x="530" y="825" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cc_def_block" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=2;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="CC-DEF-01: Explicit Default Deny All (Pre-production Audit)
Final rule drops all unmatched packets; stateful replies automatically allowed
Denied attempts logged locally and exported to CloudWatch Logs (CC-ADM-02, A21)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="420" x="530" y="1175" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pub_internet_boundary" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=2;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#60a5fa;fontColor=#1e3a8a;" value="PUBLIC INTERNET & EXTERNAL CLIENTS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="630" width="640" x="1140" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_farm" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontSize=11;" value="Farm Field Nodes (200 Farms in Cauca, Huila, Tolima):
• Crop nodes (6 readings/day) & Drying nodes (24 readings/day)
• Transmit via cellular bearer or satellite IP (out-of-coverage farms)
• 24-hour non-volatile buffer; store-and-forward drainage
• Protocol: MQTT over TLS 1.2+ to regional AWS IoT Core (CL-TEL-01)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="590" x="1165" y="185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_users" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontSize=11;" value="Public Mobile Clients (Farmer & Transporter Apps):
• Transporters: 5-minute GNSS fixes, custody events (pickup, yard, port)
• Farmers: Plot registration, alerts notification, reading history
• Protocol: HTTPS TCP 443 with Cognito auth to Public App API (CL-TEL-03)
• Offline outbox: 7-day GNSS buffer with 15-min thinning fallback" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="95" width="590" x="1165" y="290" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_lookup" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontSize=11;" value="Public Sack Lookup Consumers:
• End-buyers and public scanning sack QR codes
• Authenticates via CloudFront CDN front door (CL-PUB-01)
• Strict WAF rate limit: 30 requests/minute per source IP (PD-102)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="590" x="1165" y="395" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_services" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fontSize=11;" value="External Services & Municipal Drone Ingress:
• External NTP Servers (pool.ntp.org) & Provider DNS (CC-LNK-05)
• Vendor Firmware Updates (CC-ADM-05, TEMPORARY MAINTENANCE)
• Municipal Seat Drone Uploads: Public S3 endpoint with TLS 1.2+ (CL-DRN-03)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="590" x="1165" y="485" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext_rules_note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1.2;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;fillColor=#fef2f2;strokeColor=#f87171;fontSize=11;" value="Internet Perimeter Controls:
• CC-LNK-08: Inbound internet flows to center WAN strictly blocked
• CC-GST-04: Outbound SMTP (TCP 25) blocked from guest/transporter devices

Center Inter-Zone Defense Matrix (Section 6 & 7):
• CC-GST-01 & 02: Visitantes & Transporte denied to Logística & Gerencia [AUDIT]
• CC-GST-03: Visitantes & Transporte denied to private ranges (10.40/13, Cloud) [AUDIT]
• CC-ADM-03: User zones denied to management addresses (TCP 22/443) [AUDIT]
• CC-STF-03: Staff zones denied to each other, Logística & Guests [REVIEW]
• CC-LNK-07: Inbound tunnel traffic to center denied (except cloud admin) [AUDIT]
• CC-LNK-08: Inbound internet traffic on WAN interfaces denied [AUDIT]
• CC-LNK-09: Inter-center traffic (10.40.0.0/13) denied [REVIEW]
• CC-TEL-01: Any center traffic to telemetry_ingress denied [REVIEW]
• CC-ADM-07: Servidores locales denied general internet access [REVIEW]
• CC-LOG-04 & CC-STF-05: Non-whitelisted internet ports denied [REVIEW]

Local Gateway Services & Network Control (Priority 1):
• Gateway IP: 10.4x.Z.1 for all VLAN subinterfaces
• DHCP Server: UDP 67 (Leases: Staff 12h, Yard 4h, Guest 1h)
• DNS Resolver & Cache: UDP/TCP 53 conditional forwarding
• Local NTP Time Source: UDP 123 served locally (ASM-123)
• RADIUS Server: UDP 1812/1813 EAP-TLS with local CRL
• Guaranteed bandwidth: 2 Mbps down / 2 Mbps up (Priority 1)

div.div:
Traffic Control & Bandwidth Guarantees (Section 8):
• Priority 1: Network Control (Tunnels, DNS, NTP, RADIUS, Logs) -> 2M / 2M gtd
• Priority 2: Logistics (Receiving, scanning, code sheets) -> 44M / 11M gtd
• Priority 3: Drone (Ground station uploads & grants) -> 5M / 20M gtd (burst 61.5M up)
• Priority 4: Staff (28M / 7M gtd) & Transport App (2M / 1M gtd)
• Priority 5: Non-operational (Visitantes & Transporte) -> Cap 30M down / 7.5M up
(Per-client cap: 2 Mbps down / 0.5 Mbps up; served last with spare bandwidth)
• Failover: Non-operational traffic suspended on cellular backup (ASM-086)

[IKEv2 UDP 500, NAT-T UDP 4500, IP 50 ESP] (Pre-production Audit)
• Local Internet Breakout (NAT) for authorized staff, guest & app traffic

div.div:
Top-Down Policy Evaluation Order (Section 4):
1. CC-GST-01..03: Explicit Denies for Guest/Transport to Admin/LAN [AUDIT]
2. CC-ADM-03..04: Deny Clients to Mgmt; Deny Printers Initiating [AUDIT]
3. CC-BAS-01..04: Base Services (DHCP, DNS, NTP, RADIUS, SNMP)
4. CC-LNK-01..03: IPsec Tunnels over Primary & Cellular WAN [AUDIT]
5. CC-LNK-04..05: Route 53 Resolver (53) & Internet DNS/NTP
6. CC-LNK-06: Temporary QA Testing Path (TCP 443) [TEMP, AUDIT]
7. CC-LNK-07..09: Deny Inbound Tunnel / WAN / Other Centers [AUDIT]
8. CC-ADM-01..02: Cloud Admin (22/443) & CloudWatch Logs (443) [AUDIT]
9. CC-ADM-05..06: Vendor Updates & Laptop .60 [TEMP, AUDIT]
10. CC-DRN-01..06: Ground Station Paths to App/S3 & Deny Reserved [AUDIT]
11. CC-LOG-01..04: Logistics App API (443), Printing (631), OS Updates [AUDIT]
12. CC-STF-01..05: Staff App API (443), Printing (631), Web (80/443)
13. CC-TEL-01..02: Deny Telemetry Tier, Allow Transporter Public API
14. CC-PUB-01: Public Lookup Breakout (443)
15. CC-GST-04..05: Deny SMTP (25), Allow Capped Web Breakout
16. CC-DEF-01: Final Explicit Default Deny All (Logged) [AUDIT]

div.div:
Farm Field Nodes (200 Farms in Cauca, Huila, Tolima):
• Crop nodes (6 readings/day) & Drying nodes (24 readings/day)
• Transmit via cellular bearer or satellite IP (out-of-coverage farms)
• 24-hour non-volatile buffer; store-and-forward drainage
• Protocol: MQTT over TLS 1.2+ to regional AWS IoT Core (CL-TEL-01)

div.div:
Public Mobile Clients (Farmer & Transporter Apps):
• Transporters: 5-minute GNSS fixes, custody events (pickup, yard, port)
• Farmers: Plot registration, alerts notification, reading history
• Protocol: HTTPS TCP 443 with Cognito auth to Public App API (CL-TEL-03)
• Offline outbox: 7-day GNSS buffer with 15-min thinning fallback

CLOUD DEFENSE & OBSERVABILITY CONTROLS
• CL-EGR-01: Private tiers have NO NAT Gateway & NO default route to internet [AUDIT]
• CL-DEF-01: Explicit Default Deny across all Security Groups, NACLs & Transit Gateway [AUDIT]
• CL-DEF-02: VPC Flow Logs capture all REJECTED traffic to CloudWatch Logs with 'logs' key [REVIEW]
• CL-ADM-05: AWS Config managed rules block open SSH (22) and RDP (3389) from 0.0.0.0/0 [AUDIT]

div.div:
Cloud Firewall & Managed Policy Architecture Mapping:
• CL-LNK-01..03: TGW Route Tables route centers to 4 pdn tiers; return routes to center /16s [AUDIT]
• CL-LNK-04..05: TGW dev blackhole; temporary QA test route to Logística 10.4x.3.0/24 [AUDIT]
• CL-LNK-06..08: VPN attachments (IKEv2) [AUDIT]; transit tier stateless NACL passes center & VPC [REVIEW]
• CL-APP-01..03: Security group allows cc-staff/logistics/drone on 443 [AUDIT]; endpoint policy restricts to API ARNs [AUDIT]
• CL-DRN-01..04: SG allows cc-ground-stations to S3 endpoint [AUDIT]; endpoint policy restricts to drone bucket [AUDIT]
• CL-TEL-01..04: IoT Core MQTT 8883/443 with mutual TLS [AUDIT]; WAF Web ACL allows public app API [AUDIT]
• CL-ADM-01..04: Route 53 Resolver SG (53) & CloudWatch SG (443) [AUDIT]; session host outbound to cc-device-mgmt (22/443) [AUDIT]
• CL-PUB-01..04: CloudFront WAF rate limit 30/min [AUDIT]; SG allows CloudFront prefix list [AUDIT]; redirect 80->443 [REVIEW]
• CL-DAT-01..03: NACL denies centers to data tier [AUDIT]; SG allows store port from app tier only; gateway policy OrgID [REVIEW]
• CL-EGR-01, CL-DEF-01..02: No NAT egress [AUDIT]; explicit default deny all [AUDIT]; VPC Flow Logs capture rejected flows [REVIEW]
